testimonials.vid-routine-afro: After 3 weeks with the complete routine, my ends no longer break and my afro has regained incredible softness!
testimonials.vid-soin-karite: The balm melts right in and seals in moisture all day long. A must-have for coily hair.
testimonials.vid-pousse-serum: I apply the growth oil directly to my roots between my braids. Zero itching and visible growth in just a few weeks.
testimonials.vid-boucles-afro: Wash day is finally tear-free! Finger detangling is effortless because the hair fiber feels so soft.
testimonials.testi-1: Look at the transformation between 2024 and 2025! My hair used to be brittle and flat. With the complete routine and hair butter, my ends stopped breaking and my afro doubled in volume.
testimonials.testi-2: From 2023 to 2025, length retention on my twists and braids has been remarkable. Applying the growth oil regularly to my scalp stimulated and strengthened my roots.
testimonials.testi-3: My braids stay neat, soft, and luminous with zero tightness or scalp itching. The serum absorbs quickly without weighing my hair down.
testimonials.testi-4: Our hair has finally found its balance! No more painful detangling. The gentle shampoo cleanses without stripping, and the mist keeps moisture locked in all day.
testimonials.testi-5: The mist and leave-in are a true game changer. Two spritzes in the morning are enough to soften the fiber and restore a full, easy-to-style crown without breakage.
testimonials.testi-6: The strengthening care oil seals my high-porosity cuticles beautifully. My ends stay protected for days with a natural shine and zero greasy residue.
testimonials.testi-7: The hair butter melts effortlessly into my strands and shields my hair from sun and wind. My afro stays supple from morning to night.
testimonials.testi-8: Wash day is no longer a chore! The detangling leave-in lets the comb glide right through my coils without pulling out a single strand.
